name: Teen Internship (Summer Camp Staff)
org: Lawrence Hall of Science, UC Berkeley
what_you_do: You help run science summer camps by leading games and activities, preparing materials and supporting campers. Training is in May, and the job is full time in summer.
who_can_apply: Students entering 11th or 12th grade who can work full time all summer and attend May Saturday trainings.
pay_detail: $3,500 for the full summer ($72 deducted per missed day)
duration: June 1 to Aug 7, 2026, Monday to Friday 8:30 am to 4:30 pm; Saturday trainings in May
deadline_text: 2026 applications closed January 15, 2026. Expect a similar mid-January deadline for 2027.
how_to_apply: Apply through the Lawrence Hall of Science teen internship page when it reopens; questions to lhscamps@berkeley.edu.
notes: The page URL says 2024 but the content is the 2026 posting. The page says to apply next summer; 2027 dates are not posted. Mid-January is the 2026 pattern only.
